highlights: Whole School Safeguarding and Child Protection Policy
Designated Safeguarding Leads (DSLs) assigned to each campus
Basic medical care insurance included for all boarders
Specific policies for air quality and weather safety
safety.policy_summary: Bromsgrove International School Thailand maintains a comprehensive Safeguarding and Child Protection Policy overseen by Executive Designated Safeguarding Lead Daniel Moore and campus DSLs. The policy underscores that safeguarding is everyone's responsibility, establishing clear reporting procedures, staff codes of conduct, and support mechanisms for vulnerable students and boarders.
